'''Industrial recycling centers''' were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]]. The [[Imperial Ore Facility|Sienar Refinery]] was an industrial recycling center built from the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of an ancient [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Raxus Prime">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021024raxus|text=Raxus Prime}}</ref>
